The guideline also names a second mechanism -- enforcing the region choice via Organization Policy resource-location constraints -- which is an organizational-governance control, not just a technical placement decision.

Shifting flexible compute-intensive jobs to run during clean-energy windows is the same carbon-aware temporal-shifting pattern that maps onto BPMN timer-driven scheduling of deferrable process instances, though here it's scoped to training/batch-inference workloads specifically.

The 4Ms framework guides resource selection for individual ML workloads; it's a task-implementation methodology, not a process-modeling concern.
